llm_text: I probably disagree — I still don’t think a full‑blown civil war in the U.S. is likely. People in my rural community are mostly focused on jobs, family, church and schools, and a nationwide uprising would need broad grassroots support and serious logistics we just don’t have; that said, local political violence is real, so sensible preparedness, strong community ties, and leaning on faith and local leaders make sense.
